name: How should I prepare before hiring a contractor for basement door framing?

mainEntity.name: How should I prepare before hiring a contractor for basement door framing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before the contractor arrives, you should determine the door swing direction, select your door style, and clear the work area. Measure your hallway clearances to confirm whether the door should swing inward or outward, especially around stairs or mechanical equipment. Clarify whether your basement ceiling height is standard or low, as ductwork or soffits may require a custom-cut door height. You should also decide whether you prefer solid core doors for sound dampening in basement home theaters or bedrooms, and clear at least six feet of space around the doorway.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the room, determine the door swing direction, verify ceiling heights under ductwork, and decide if you need solid-core slabs for sound dampening.
